meaning: pork ribs in black bean sauce
usage: 豉汁排骨 (si6 zap1 paai4 gwat1) is a noun and refers to a specific dim sum dish made of pork ribs cooked in black bean sauce.
You can use 豉汁排骨 as the subject or object of a sentence, e.g., 我鍾意食豉汁排骨 (I like eating pork ribs in black bean sauce).
This word is typically used when ordering food at a dim sum restaurant or talking about dishes.
豉汁排骨 is countable when referring to plates or servings, e.g., 我哋叫咗兩份豉汁排骨 (We ordered two portions of pork ribs in black bean sauce).
